summary: End-to-end ML platforms unify training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, model registry, deployment, and monitoring into a single governed environment, which becomes essential once teams move beyond prototypes to production models that need reproducibility, scaling, and governance. In 2026 the landscape has split into cloud-native suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML), data-platform-centric lakehouses (Databricks), automated ML products (DataRobot, H2O.ai), and lightweight MLOps/compute tooling (Weights & Biases, Modal). If you only need to call a hosted LLM or vision model, a simple model API is sufficient — you need a full platform when you train/fine-tune your own models, require experiment governance, or must deploy and monitor models at enterprise scale.

platforms.name: Amazon SageMaker AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/instance-hour, storage, and endpoint usage; no upfront fees
platforms.best_for: Teams already on AWS wanting a modular, AWS-native ML workshop with deep infrastructure and deployment control

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute, training hours, prediction nodes, and GenAI token usage
platforms.best_for: GCP-based teams wanting highly automated, state-of-the-art training with strong AutoML and Gemini integration

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute instance, with enterprise commitment/reserved options
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft/Azure ecosystem needing governance, security, and Azure OpenAI integration

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based (DBUs) on top of underlying cloud compute; per-second billing
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting a unified multi-cloud data intelligence platform spanning data, analytics, ML, and AI governance

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage-based team and enterprise plans
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and model lineage across any training stack

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free open-source; managed versions billed via Databricks or hosting provider
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting a vendor-neutral, open-source standard for experiment tracking and model registry

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated ML and governance for business analysts and data science teams with minimal coding

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core; enterprise subscription for H2O AI Cloud / Driverless AI
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting open-source AutoML with strong explainability and generative AI extensions

platforms.name: Kubeflow
platforms.pricing: Free open-source; pay only for underlying Kubernetes infrastructure
platforms.best_for: Platform teams standardizing ML workflows on Kubernetes with full control and portability

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second billing for CPU/GPU compute; free starter credits
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting fast serverless GPU compute for training, fine-tuning, and deploying models without managing infrastructure

platforms.name: Metaflow
platforms.pricing: Free open-source; managed via Outerbounds subscription
platforms.best_for: Data science teams wanting a human-centric, Python-first framework for scalable, production ML workflows
